title: FairJudge: MLLM Judging for Social-Attributes and Prompt–Image Alignment
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and benchmarks 'religion' as one of its six core social attributes. It includes a specific religious taxonomy (Christian, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Jewish, Sikh, Shinto, Neutral) within its new DIVERSIFY dataset and reports accuracy and distribution metrics for these religious categories across multiple models.
